symptoms: Fault code appears after ABS controller was replaced
Coding is accepted, but is lost after a key cycle
Code clears, but comes right back
commonCauses: Incorrect ABS controller / hydraulic unit part number compatibility
stepByStepSolution: Use correct ABS controller, part number must be check by original vehicle's VIN
technicalNotes:
When found in ABS ESP MK60EC1 controllers be 100% sure the correct part number is used.
Suppression as per manufacture parts catalog (ETKA) are okay
